description: This file defines a router for calendar-related commands in a trading platform, including IPOs, dividends, splits, events, and earnings. It sets up command handlers that invoke queries to retrieve financial calendar data.

methods.name: OBBject ipo( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )

methods.name: OBBject events( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
